description: Runs locally and offline. Finds crypto wallet keys (BIP39 seed phrases with checksum, EVM and Solana private keys, WIF, xprv), API secrets (GitHub, AWS, Stripe, OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack, Telegram, npm, JWT, PEM, credentialed URLs, password= assignments) and PII (cards, IBAN, SSN, email, phone, IP). Returns verdict (WALLET_KEY_EXPOSED / SECRETS_FOUND / PII_FOUND / CLEAN), safe_to_send and findings with masked previews (never the secret). Pattern and validator based detection: it can miss secrets in unknown formats and can flag look-alikes. A clean result is not a guarantee.

style.description: label: [REDACTED:type] (default); mask: keep last 4 digits / email domain for PII
